context:
Goal: the Orphaned composer 12 pt margin pull request (PR 389) merges.
Problem (rule): the merge tool refuses a pull request whose own run is red, and PR 389's Duo shards are green but its Pro-phone shards are red on the known 9 failing tests, so dropping that label on this pull request too is a variant of your 2026-11-22 12:27 CST pick (drop it on the Hand word pull request only) and needs your word.
Based on (measured): run 45055010276 shows the Duo job green for the flat and closed screens; the Pro-phone shards a to d are red.
Based on (ruling): decisions/native-ci-on-hosted-macos (2026-11-08 16:50 CST): hosted macOS CI is the only place native work runs; option c reopens it.
Based on (read): the coordinator reports that at about 12:37 CST you offered, in chat, to port it to a local session when the cloud work is done, for simulator testing ("handover when done").
Departs from: main keeps the Pro label on PR 389 — the change removes it, which costs one new head (a merge of main).
Waiting on: your answer; PR 389 and the other native pull requests wait, the other lanes run.

options.gain: PR 389 merges on its green Duo shards.
options.how: The coordinator removes the label and merges main into PR 389, then the runner merges it on green.
options.label: Drop the Pro label on PR 389 too
options.lose: The Pro shards never run on the Orphaned change, so a real regression on those screens goes unseen.

options.gain: Full screen proof on every native change.
options.how: Nothing changes; a fix lane for the 9 tests would have to start first.
options.label: Keep the label and wait for the 9 tests to be fixed
options.lose: PR 389 and every native pull request wait on a fix you said not to dig into now.

options.gain: PR 389 merges now, and the Orphaned screens still get one real simulator run.
options.how: The coordinator removes the label now and holds a list of the Orphaned screens to test; when the cloud work is done you port it to a local session, which runs the simulator once.
options.label: Drop the label, and test the Orphaned screens once in a local session later
options.lose: It takes your time, it goes past your hosted-only ruling for native work, and a regression could land before the test.

title: May the Pro-phone label also be dropped on the Orphaned margin pull request so it can merge?
why: It follows your 12:27 CST pick (drop the label on the Hand word PR, no digging) and the Duo shards are green; c adds one real simulator run in a local session if your offer should override the hosted-only ruling (coordinator recommended c; I recommend a, unmeasured).
